title: lbm-nca-thesis: Neural Cellular Automata for CFD in Architectural Design
description: Research code for a neural-cellular-automata surrogate of steady-state mean wind flow around urban building layouts. Covers procedural geometry generation with a 14-dimensional geometric descriptor, a GPU lattice-Boltzmann (D2Q9 MRT-LES) solver that produces the ground-truth dataset, training of the TES-NCA surrogate, and a WebSocket bridge for real-time inference inside Rhino/Grasshopper. Accompanies a master's thesis at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University.
